comment: Can only modify tryptophan in 4-position. Enzyme shows some substrate promiscuity (L-tryptophan derivatives) but does not accept D-tryptophan.

reactions.description: Nitrates free-floating L-tryptophan as the first committed step in the thaxtomin biosynthetic pathway.
Nitrates L-tryptophan exclusively in 4-position. D-tryptophan is not accepted
